Hi Emma / Tom —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and the asks you flagged so we have alignment before we send the DPA draft and SOC artifacts: 

- Scope: Inference-only usage for the customer-facing search assistant; no upstream model training on any Skyward data unless explicitly opted in.
- Training opt-out: Skyward requests a written confirmation that Redwood will not use customer request or fine-tuning data to improve any shared model weights or public-model training pipelines.
- PII handling: Sensitive identifiers (SSNs, tax IDs, unredacted PII) should be redacted or routed through your pseudonymization flow. If Redwood receives them, they must be masked in logs and not used for training.
- Retention: Preferred default retention of logs/requests = 90 days; legal may request 30-day retention for audit-only buckets. Please confirm which option you prefer.
- Logging & access: Request that access to raw logs be restricted to named SRE/encryption key-holders and that audit logs capture viewer identity + purpose.
- Data residency: EU-only storage (eu-west-1).

Next steps I propose:
1) We (Redwood) will send a DPA draft and SOC2 summary today.
2) Please sign the training-opt-out acknowledgement (I can provide a one-page form) and indicate retention selection (30/90/365).
3) Aditya (cc'd) will follow up on technical controls for masking / KV-cache policies.

Attachments for initial review: DPA_draft.docx (draft), SOC2_summary.pdf.

If that matches your understanding, reply with the signed opt-out or a short "confirmed" and your retention choice.

Hi Neha / Emma —

Thanks — quick technical confirmation and language you can use in the DPA / vendor acknowledgement: 

1) Non-use for training: Redwood will not route Skyward customer requests, log traces, or derived embeddings into any model training or public model-improvement pipelines. Internally we mark tenant-scoped data with a "no-train" tag; those data paths are excluded from downstream training exports. This is enforced at the ingestion & dataset-export stages.

2) Logging & retention: By default, request logs and anonymized telemetry are retained for 90 days in hot storage (for debugging/alerts). If Skyward elects 30-day retention, we will adjust the lifecycle policy on your project bucket to expire data after 30 days. For long-term audit requests we support a separate read-only archive with restricted access.

3) PII handling: Any fields identified as PII by Skyward (explicit list provided during onboarding) can be masked at the edge; where masking is not available we can redact before persistence. We log redaction events in an audit-only channel.

4) Data residency & keys: All customer data will be stored in eu-west-1; customer-managed KMS can be integrated so keys never leave your control. Access to raw logs is limited to named SREs and requires explicit approval; all access is recorded in the audit trail.

Sample wording for DPA clause: 
"Redwood Inference acknowledges and confirms that Customer data (including requests, logs, and derived artifacts) for Skyward Analytics will not be used to train or improve Redwood's public or shared models unless Customer provides explicit, documented consent. Redwood will apply tenant-scoped exclusion tags and enforce them at ingestion and dataset-export. Logs will be retained according to the retention policy selected by Customer (default: 90 days) and stored exclusively in EU (eu-west-1)."

I'll attach the SOC2 summary and a copy of the signed opt-out we received (for your records). Happy to hop on a quick technical call if needed.

Best —
